paragraphs: Current makes commercial lighting and lighting controls. The stated mission is to craft intelligent LED lighting and controls for smarter, more efficient environments. Architects and designers are named among the people these products are meant to serve.

Indoor categories include emergency lighting units. Outdoor listings cover area, site and roadway products. On the controls side, Site Manager is described as a way to view and control recurring schedules, manage energy use and meet code requirements. The NX App is used to configure and clone devices from one interface. Specifiers can search photometry files on the site.

A utility rebate search is published as well. Buyers are also pointed to a customer experience portal. The company states that it has invented and evolved lighting for over 200 years. Quick-ship and in-stock product options are presented as how deadlines get met. The copyright notice on the site names HLI Solutions, Inc.
